{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
data['customer_age'] = data['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Remove rows with revenue = '999,999.99' (QA orders)
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
data_clean['revenue'] = data_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data_clean['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data_clean['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the final shape
print(f"Final number of completed orders (after removing QA and refunded): {len(data_clean)}")

# Check the distribution of channels and segments
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(data_clean['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(data_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if channel and segment are confounded
print("\nChannel vs. Customer Segment cross-tabulation:")
print(pd.crosstab(data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment']))"}
